collection.title: Honda e-Ny1 2023 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Honda e-Ny1 2023 Onwards model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
